title: Local-First Web P2P Relay & LTAP Storage Primitives
description: Implements WebRTC signaling & WebSocket fallback stream relay for browser artifacts (resolving the ch01-a-million-apps.md paradox) alongside isolated SQLite LTAP analytical/transactional data storage.
keyDecisions: LOCAL-FIRST P2P WITH RELAY FALLBACK. Generated browser artifacts run P2P using WebRTC CRDT sync. Taawun provides signaling and WebSocket relay when browser/NAT constraints prevent direct P2P mesh creation.
